title: Pia Carrot 2 (Japan): native cartridge-bus and test edits
summary: Replace two original ASR0 stores and the original cartridge-memory test call in A100.BIN.
rationale: All three edits belong to original A100.BIN at LBA218. Two stores write 23301FF0 to SCU ASR0 at 25FE00B0; keep adjacent AREF=13 writes. The skipped call tests cartridge memory with write/read/complement passes. Retain its following NOP, CMP/PZ, saved outer PR and native error/return paths; do not invent a success return. Original A.BIN and A001 loader pointers remain unchanged. Production decoder and complete source checks pass. Both 18000-frame original-callback comparisons match all sampled video; their audio differs before A100 loads. With no RAM cartridge, the direct overlay matches the unmodified game at all checkpoints and in complete PCM. The unmodified 4 MiB run diverges after A100 loads; further test/bank-path evidence remains open. These are cartridge-bus/test edits, not CDON. No inserted code, resident callback or RAM writer. Keep inactive pending real Saturn audio/bus, bank/reset and other-program checks.
